title: Gear Premium 3.75″ Ash Catcher Mouthpiece Hand Pipe
description: This 3.75-inch hand pipe from Gear Premium is equipped with a built-in ash catcher at the mouthpiece to direct smoke straight into the lung and keep ash from getting in the mouth. Besides, the pipe is constructed of durable borosilicate glass with a 24K gold decal for a high-class look.
